purpose: Configuration A of acceptance criterion 21. DEVELOPMENT AND CI TEST ENVIRONMENT ONLY. Never a runtime dependency of the theme or plugin, never bundled in a package.
owner_approval: Approved by the owner for M2 Configuration A, official WordPress.org plugin only, exact version pinned.
zip_sha256_note: Deliberately blank. It is obtained only from the official WordPress.org package in a hosted capture run, reviewed by a person, and committed by a reviewed change. No script ever writes this file.

compatibility_basis.plugin_tested_up_to: 7.0 (above the pinned WordPress; 'tested up to' is advisory, 'requires at least' is the limit)
compatibility_basis.release_date_note: 1.7.0 changelog: a hotfix for WordPress 7.0 publishing-actions styling; previous stable 1.6.7 fixed script translations in WordPress 6.7.1. Neither release is reported as dropping support for WordPress 6.4.

identified_from.evidence: readme.txt 'Stable tag: 1.7.0'; classic-editor.php header 'Version: 1.7.0'; changelog entry 1.7.0 present
identified_from.limitation: This is the plugin's official development repository, linked from its WordPress.org page. It is NOT the WordPress.org distribution. The repository has no tags, so the release commit could not be tied to the 1.7.0 package. The WordPress.org package itself was not reachable and has not been verified yet.

verification_in_ci: download the exact source URL above
record the package SHA-256 (and compare with zip_sha256 once it is filled in)
check the plugin header version equals the pinned version
install it and run wp plugin verify-checksums against WordPress.org's published per-file checksums for that exact version
check the installed version equals the pinned version (C21-021)
record the Classic Editor settings used for the run (C21-022)

verification.rule: state may become 'verified' only through a reviewed change that fills every field below. While 'unverified', the strict install mode refuses to run, so C21-021 cannot be reported as satisfied.
